page.layout: One page of text, verse in italics at top, then prose paragraphs with one marginal note right beside the second paragraph ("Amasis."); catchword-like signature line at the foot: "V" centred and "Deinde" at right. Running head "PARS SECUNDA" at top, page number 229 at top right.

l.i: Fluminis hic nullum Lippia flumen habet.
Obviat Haltremum, dextro quod limite surgit;
Eminus ac ovium vellere curat opus.
Asper Boumbergus sequitur mons latus ab illo
Stevera quem sociat Lippia dexter aquus.
Solis ad exortum primo defertur ab orta
Pestea morbosi fertur in arva nothi.
Postea Lippiaco totus in amne perit.
Nomine iam dubio virginis aula latet.
Arguit hoc radix nominis atque loci.

main_text.l: Amasis vel Amasus à fonte Lupiæ 40 stadiis versus
Septentrionem distat, ubi arces Teutoburgenses, hodie Tecklenburgh &
Iburgensis, campus v storiosus, rivus roseus, aliaque Variana cladis
vestigia etiamnum prostant: de quo ita Fiedlerus Poëta:

l.i: Profluit Hassiacis Amasus de fontibus ortus,
Et per Westphalicam caerulus errat humum.
Has vbi caeruleo peragravit flumine terras,
Vda rebellantis Frisii sed at crasigatque
Inde via fessus cumuloque gravatus aquarum

main_text.l: Alius igitur hic est Amasus ab Æmsuri, qui Ruram
prope pagum Beeckium incurrit, & cum eo Rhenum intrat, ut
Invenies quoque in Marchia fontes limpidissimos,
sylvas amoenissimas, pascua & prata florida, ut lumen VVestphaliæ non
immerito dici, nomenque ipsum à Medulla
Sed ad ipsos hujus Marcæ VVestphalicæ

page.notes: Marginal note "Amasis." at right beside the paragraph beginning "Amasis vel Amasus". Verse lines are italic; some letters in the scan are blurred, particularly in the verse, so some readings are uncertain. Catchword "Deinde" and signature "V" at the foot as printed.
